findings.title: Remove integration-ticket branch restrictions from the reusable Git guide
findings.trigger: A later Andino task selects Git change grouping or versioning in a suitable project checkout whose branch is neither main nor andino-workflow, without an explicit branch instruction that overrides the guide.
findings.consequence: The general method incorrectly carries this integration ticket's rule into the later task: it can report the valid checkout as blocked or route runtime/QA work to irrelevant branch names. This conflicts with the reusable root's current-user/current-project authority and the isolation method's suitable-current-checkout rule.

evidence.quote: This ticket allows runtime only on existing andino-workflow and QA only on existing main. No new branch.
Reuse suitable current/attached worktree and explicit branch/location preference. Inspect actual state before creating anything.

evidence.interpretation: The main-plane decision correctly describes existing main/andino-workflow branches as restrictions of this integration ticket; those restrictions are not portable generic-method defaults.

findings.minimum_remedy: Keep the concrete branch restrictions in this ticket's plan/evidence. Replace the runtime sentence with an instruction to honor the active task's actual branch/location policy, reuse a suitable authorized checkout, and never create or switch branches without applicable authority. Regenerate the candidate and add a bounded regression asserting the general guide does not contain ticket-specific branch names.
findings.proof: Exact runtime line inspected; actual/candidate byte parity establishes the same defect exists in the candidate. No branch mutation or hypothetical live failure was performed.
